blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models are widely used as judges of model outputs (LLM-as-a-Judge), but they are costly and can hallucinate or be overconfident. Decision models are a potential alternative. They return a predefined verdict with a probability for each label instead of free-form text and are much cheaper and faster. We test this promise on hallucination detection. We build binary benchmarks for five hallucination types (9,852 items from six datasets) and compare five decision models with the generative judge gpt-6-sol. Performance depends strongly on the type: the best decision model matches gpt-6-sol in balanced accuracy on context inconsistency and comes within 3 percentage points on factual errors, but trails it by 4-8 points on logical and instruction inconsistency. Decision-model probabilities are overconfident, though less so than the GPT-6 models, and separate correct from incorrect decisions only moderately. We also find that a confidence cascade of decision models improves on the best single model by 1.9-3.3 points on three types and matches or exceeds gpt-6-sol at 1-3% of its cost. Overall, decision models are a practical low-cost judge for some hallucination types but need to be validated before use.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型被广泛用作模型输出(LLM-as-a-Judge)的评委,但它们成本高昂,可以产生幻觉或过于自信. 决策模式是一个潜在的替代办法。 他们返回一个预定义的判断,每个标签都有概率,而不是自由格式的文本,而且更便宜更快. 我们用幻觉检测来测试这个承诺 我们为5个幻觉类型(从6个数据集得来的9,852个项目)建立二进制基准,并将5个决定模型与基因判官gpt-6-sol进行比较. 性能主要取决于类型:最佳决定模型与上下文不一致的平衡精确度相匹配gpt-6-sol,在3个百分点内与事实错误相匹配,但在逻辑和指令不一致上却比分了4-8分. 决策模型概率过于自信,虽然比GPT-6模型要低,并且只是略微地将正确与错误的决定分开. 我们还发现,决策模型的置信级联以成本的1-3 %,在三种类型和相匹配或超过gpt-6-sol的情况下提高了最佳单一模型的1.9-3.3分。 总体而言,决策模型对于某些幻觉类型来说是一种实用的低成本判断,但在使用前需要验证.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as judges of model outputs, an approach often called LLM-as-a-Judge Gu et al. (2026) ; Zheng et al. (2023) . They rate open-ended responses Verga et al. (2024) ; Badshah et al. (2025) , check whether responses follow instructions Wen et al. (2026) ; Zeng et al. (2024) , and detect hallucinated content Li et al. (2023) ; Tang et al. (2024) ; Xu et al. (2026) ; Manakul et al. (2023) . However, LLM judges are not fully reliable themselves. They can hallucinate, produce incorrect or unsupported judgments, and be overconfident in their judgments Kadavath et al. (2022) ; Tian et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)被广泛用作模型输出的裁判,这种方法常被称为LLM-as-a-Judge Gu等人(2026年);郑等人(2023年). Verga等人(2024年);Badshah等人(2025年),检查答复是否遵循指示。 Wen等人(2026年);Zeng等人(2024年),并检测到幻觉内容Li等人(2023年);Tang等人(2024年);徐等人(2026年);Manakul等人(2023年). 然而,LLM法官本身并不完全可靠。 他们可能会产生幻觉,产生不正确或不支持的判断,并在判决中过度自信Kadavath等人(2022年);Tian等人(2023年).

blocks.en: Recently released decision models offer a different kind of judge. Models such as jev TypeSafe AI (2026) , d1 AI (2026) , and Perplexity Decider Bespoke Labs and Sathiamoorthy (2026) do not generate free-form assessments but choose among predefined verdicts and return a probability for each. This design has two potential advantages. First, providers present these probabilities as a measure of certainty, so reliable probabilities can show when a judgment should not be trusted TypeSafe AI (2026) . Second, decision models are much cheaper and faster than generative LLMs, which matters for large-scale evaluation Li et al. (2026) ; Rao and Callison-Burch (2026) ; Ibrahim and Zaki (2026) .
blocks.zh: 最近公布的判决模式提供了另一种法官。 Jev TypeSafe AI(2026),d1 AI(2026),以及Perplexity Consulture Bespok Labs和Sathiamoorty(2026)等模型不会产生自由式评估,而是在预先定义的判断中选择,并返回每个模型的概率. 这种设计有两个潜在的优点. 首先,提供商提出这些概率作为确定性的衡量标准,因此,可靠的概率可以显示某项判断何时不应被TypeSafe AI(2026)信任. 第二,决策模型比基因LLMS便宜得多,更快,后者对Li等人(2026年)进行大规模评价至关重要;Rao和Callison-Burch(2026年);Ibrahim和Zaki(2026年).

blocks.en: Whether these advantages hold is still unclear. Recent studies of decision models as judges each examine a single model Li et al. (2026) ; Rao and Callison-Burch (2026) , leaving several questions open. First, judge performance varies across tasks Xu et al. (2025) , but how consistently decision models perform across error types is unknown. Second, whether their probabilities are calibrated and separate correct judgments from errors has merely been tested Xie et al. (2025) . Third, multi-judge studies Verga et al. (2024) ; Ma et al. (2025) have not tested ensembles composed solely of decision models for hallucination detection.
blocks.zh: 这些优势是否存在尚不清楚。 最近关于作为法官的判决模式的研究分别审查了单一模式的Li等人(2026年);Rao和Callison-Burch(2026年),留下了若干问题。 首先,法官的业绩因任务许等人(2025年)不同而不同,但不同错误类型之间如何一致的决策模式如何执行却不得而知。 第二,它们的概率是否经过校准,是否将正确判断与错误分开,只是经过了谢等人的测试(2025年). 第三,多法官研究Verga等人(2024年);Ma等人(2025年)没有测试仅由幻觉检测决定模型组成的综艺节目.

blocks.en: We address these gaps in the context of hallucination detection. First, judge reliability matters most here, since a judge that hallucinates while checking for hallucinations defeats its purpose. Second, hallucination types require different evidence (world knowledge, sources, the response itself, or the prompt), so they test whether decision models can generalize. We ask three research questions:
blocks.zh: 我们在发现幻觉时处理这些差距。 首先,判断可靠性在这里最为重要,因为一个在检查幻觉时产生幻觉的法官会破坏它的目的. 其次,幻觉类型需要不同的证据(世界知识,来源,反应本身,或即时),因此它们检验决策模型是否能够概括. 我们提出三个研究问题:

blocks.en: • RQ1. How accurately do decision models detect different hallucination types? • RQ2. How reliable is their confidence? • RQ3. Can ensembles of decision models improve detection accuracy?
blocks.zh: • RQ1。 决策模型如何准确发现不同的幻觉类型? • RQ2。 他们的信心有多可靠? • RQ3。 决策模型的组合能否提高检测准确性?

blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-03-03). RQ1. 决策模型如何准确发现不同的幻觉类型?

blocks.en: RQ2. How reliable is their confidence?
blocks.zh: RQ2 (英语). 他们的信心有多可靠?

blocks.en: RQ3. Can ensembles of decision models improve detection accuracy?
blocks.zh: RQ3(英语:RQ3. 决策模型的组合能否提高检测准确性?

blocks.en: We evaluate five decision models against the generative LLM gpt-6-sol on 9,852 samples from six datasets based on five hallucination types Huang et al. (2025) . Our results show that decision models can match gpt-6-sol on some hallucination types at a small fraction of its cost, and that most of them are only mildly overconfident. Confidence cascades of decision models further improve the accuracy of hallucination detection. Overall, our results show that decision models are a practical low-cost judge for some hallucination types but should be validated before use.
blocks.zh: 我们从六个数据集对9,852个基因LLM gpt-6-sol样本的5个决定模型进行评估,这些样本基于5种幻觉类型Huang等人(2025年)。 我们的结果显示,决策模型可以比对一些幻觉类型上的gpt-6-sol,其成本只有一小部分,而且大多数只是轻微的过度自信. 决策模型的信心级联进一步提高了幻觉检测的准确性. 总的来说,我们的结果表明,对于某些幻觉类型来说,决定模型是一种实用的低成本判断,但在使用前应当经过验证。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-Judge and Decision Models. LLM-as-a-Judge is widely used for automated evaluation. LLM judges can align with human evaluations ( Min et al., 2023 ) but also show biases such as position and verbosity bias ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , and because they generate text, they add cost and latency. In contrast, decision models provide a non-generative alternative by directly selecting from predefined labels and returning their associated probabilities. Recent work evaluates jev on HaluEval factuality and final-answer adjudication ( Li et al., 2026 ) , as well as on rubric criteria ( Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) , and reports lower cost and latency than generative LLM judges. Ibrahim and Zaki (2026) compare several decision models on social-science annotation.
blocks.zh: LLM-as-a-法官与裁决模式。 LLM-as-a法官被广泛用于自动化评价. LLM评委可以与人类评价保持一致(Min等人,2023年),但也表现出立场和马鞭草偏差(郑等人,2023年;刘等人,2023年)等偏差,由于产生文字,增加了成本和耐久性. 相比之下,决策模型通过直接从预定义的标签中选择并返回其相关概率,提供了一个非遗传性替代品. 近期的工作评价了jev关于HaluEval的事实和最后的答案裁定(Li等人,2026年),以及标题标准(Rao和Callison-Burch,2026年),并报告说成本和耐性低于基因LLM法官。 易卜拉欣和扎基(2026年)比较了社会科学注释的几个决定模型.

blocks.en: Hallucination detection. Detecting a hallucination requires evidence depending on its type ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . FAVABench and HADTest annotate factual errors ( Mishra et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , RAGTruth annotates unsupported or contradictory content in retrieval-grounded responses ( Niu et al., 2024 ) , ContraDoc and ROSCOE cover contradictions within documents and reasoning chains ( Li et al., 2024 ; Golovneva et al., 2023 ) , and IF-RewardBench covers instruction following ( Wen et al., 2026 ) . AggreFact shows that factuality detector performance varies across datasets, summarizers, and error types ( Tang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 幻觉检测. 检测幻觉需要根据其类型提供证据(Huang等人,2025年)。 FAVA Bench和HADETest对事实错误进行了注释(Mishra等人,2024年;徐等人,2026年),RAGTruth在检索依据的答复中给出了不支持或矛盾的内容(Niu等人,2024年),ContraDoc和ROSCOE涵盖了文件和推理链中的矛盾(Li等人,2024年;Golovneva等人,2023年),IF-Reward Bench涵盖了以下指示(Wen等人,2026年)。 阿格丽 事实表明,事实探测器的性能因数据集、摘要和错误类型而异(Tang等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Confidence reliability. Returning probabilities does not make a judge’s confidence reliable. Calibration asks whether probabilities match observed frequencies ( Guo et al., 2017 ) , and error ranking asks whether confidence separates correct judgments from errors. Language-model confidence can reflect correctness, but this depends on the task and on how confidence is elicited ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Tian et al., 2023 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ) . For decision models, calibration varies by workload ( Li et al., 2026 ; Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) , and high confidence can coexist with near-chance accuracy ( Ibrahim and Zaki, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 信心可靠性. 回归概率并不使法官的信心可靠。 校准询问概率是否与观测到的频率相匹配(Guo等人,2017年),错误排名则询问信心是否将正确判断与错误区分开来. 语言模型自信可以反映正确性,但这取决于任务和如何激发信心(Kadavath等人,2022年;Tian等人,2023年;Xiong等人,2024年)。 对于决定模型,校准因工作量不同而异(Li等人,2026年;Rao和Callison-Burch,2026年),高度信心可以与近切精度共存(Ibrahim和Zaki,2026年).

blocks.en: Judge ensembles and cascades. Combining judges helps when their errors differ. PoLL aggregates judgments from diverse generative models ( Verga et al., 2024 ) , and CLEV calls a third judge only when the first two disagree ( Badshah et al., 2025 ) , the idea behind our arbitration method. Confidence-based cascades pass uncertain items to another judge ( Jung et al., 2025 ) . JEV-to-generative cascades can match the generative judge at lower cost ( Li et al., 2026 ) , although overlapping errors limit their gains on rubric tasks ( Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 法官综艺节目和级联。 当法官的错误不同时,合并法官会有所帮助。 PoLL汇总了来自不同基因模型(Verga等人,2024年)的判断,而CLEV只在前两者意见不一(Badshah等人,2025年),即我们仲裁方法背后的理念时才调用第三法官. 基于信任的级联将不确定项目交给另一名法官(Jung等人,2025年)。 JEV-转基因级联可以以更低的成本与基因裁判相匹配(Li等人,2026年),尽管重叠错误限制了它们在路标任务上的收益(Rao and Callison-Burch, 2026年).

blocks.en: Three areas remain underexplored. First, decision models have so far been evaluated one at a time or on tasks other than hallucination detection, so it is unclear how well they detect each hallucination type. Second, few studies have examined whether the confidence of decision models is reliable across models and hallucination types. Third, it has not been tested whether ensembles built only from decision models can improve hallucination detection while keeping their cost low. Our study aims to address these research gaps.
blocks.zh: 仍有三个地区未得到充分探索。 首先,到目前为止,决策模型已经被一次评估一次,或者在除幻觉检测之外的任务上评估一次,所以目前还不清楚这些模型对每种幻觉类型的检测程度. 第二,很少研究过决策模型在模型和幻觉类型中是否可靠。 第三,没有测试仅从决策模型中构建的综艺节目是否能够改善幻觉检测,同时保持低成本. 我们的研究旨在弥补这些研究差距。

blocks.en: 3 Data and Methods
blocks.zh: 3 数据和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Composition
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准构成

blocks.en: Hallucination types. Hallucination takes several forms. Following the taxonomy of Huang et al. (2025) , we study five types (Table 1 ). Factual contradiction (FC) covers claims that contradict verifiable real-world facts. Factual fabrication (FF) covers unverifiable or unsupported overclaims. Context inconsistency (CI) covers claims that conflict with the supplied source material or are not supported by it. Logical inconsistency (LI) covers contradictions within a response or between its reasoning steps. Instruction inconsistency (II) covers violations of explicit instructions. We treat each type as a separate binary task, because one response can contain several types of error.
blocks.zh: 迷幻类型. 迷幻有多种形式. 继黄等人的分类学(2025)之后,我们研究了五种类型(表1). 事实矛盾(FC)涵盖与可核实的现实世界事实相矛盾的主张. 事实捏造(FF)涵盖无法核实或无根据的过度索赔。 上下文不一致(CI)包括声称与所提供来源材料有冲突或得不到其支持。 逻辑上的不一致(LI)涵盖了反应内部或其推理步骤之间的矛盾. 指令不一致(二)包括违反明确指令的行为。 我们把每个类型作为一个单独的二进制任务,因为一个响应可以包含几种类型的错误.

blocks.en: Benchmark datasets. We choose six benchmarks whose annotations mark the target error type explicitly, so each sample maps to a binary label without new annotation ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024 ) . For FC and FF, we combine two datasets that annotate both types, given that FAVABench alone has fewer than 400 samples per type. FAVABench contains ChatGPT and Llama responses with human span-level error annotations ( Mishra et al., 2024 ) . HADTest contains responses into which GPT-4o injected a single factual error, validated by two annotators ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . For CI, RAGTruth contains responses from six LLMs to question answering, summarization, and data-to-text tasks, annotated for content that conflicts with the retrieved source or is unsupported by it ( Niu et al., 2024 ) . For II, IF-RewardBench contains responses from 16 LLMs, each checked against a list of explicit constraints ( Wen et al., 2026 ) . For LI, ContraDoc contains news, Wikipedia, and story documents with inserted self-contradictions ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and ROSCOE contains step-by-step reasoning annotated for contradictions ( Golovneva et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 基准数据集。 我们选择了六个基准,其说明明确标注目标错误类型,因此每个样本地图到二进制标签时都没有新的注释(Tang等人,2023;Tang等人,2024). 就FC和FF而言,我们合并了两个数据组,对两种类型都进行注释,因为单FAVA Bench的每个类型样本不到400个. FAVA Bench 包含 ChatGPT和Llama用人类跨度误差说明(Mishra等人,2024年)的反应. HAD Test载有一些答复,GPT-4o在答复中注入了一个单一的事实错误,经两个注释员验证(Xu等人,2026年)。 对于CI来说,RAGTruth包含来自6个LLMs对提问回答,总结,以及数据到文本任务的答复,对与检索来源冲突或不受其支持的内容附加了说明(Niu等人,2024年). 第二,IF-Reward Bench载有16个有限责任公司的答复,每个公司都对照一份明确的限制清单(Wen等人,2026年)。 对 LI, 反 Doc包含新闻,维基百科,以及带有插入自译自审功能的故事文件(Li等人,2024年),ROSCOE包含对矛盾附加说明的一步步推理(Golovneva等人,2023年).

blocks.en: An item is labeled H H if its source annotation marks the target error and N N if it marks the absence of that hallucination error. An N N sample may therefore still contain another type of hallucination. We keep each dataset’s evaluation unit and do not rebalance the classes. Appendix A.3 details how we map each dataset’s original annotations to the binary labels used in our evaluation.
blocks.zh: 如果物品的来源注释标志着目标错误,而N N标志没有幻觉错误,则标注为H H。 因此,NN样本可能仍然含有另一种类型的幻觉。 我们保留每个数据集的评价单位,不重新平衡各个类别。 附录A.3详细列出了我们如何将每个数据集的原始说明映射到我们评价中使用的二进制标签。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Setup and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价设置和计量

blocks.en: Model selection. We select five decision models from five providers, including both proprietary and open-weight models. They are jev , d1 , clef , pplx , and gpt-6-luna . Details of these models are presented in Appendix B . For comparison, we also run the general-purpose generative LLM gpt-6-sol on the same items, distinguishing it from gpt-6-luna , which is included as a decision model because it directly outputs classification decisions. All six models are accessed through their hosted APIs. Latency is therefore end-to-end API response time and does not depend on local hardware.
blocks.zh: 型号选择. 我们从五个提供商中选择五个决策模式,包括专有型和开放型。 他们是jev, d1, clef, pplx, 和gpt-6-luna。 这些模型的详细情况见附录B。 为了比较起见,我们还在同一项目上运行了通用基因LLM gpt-6-sol,将其与gpt-6-luna区分开来,它作为一个决定模型被列入其中,因为它直接输出分类决定. 所有六个模型都通过它们的主机API访问. latency因此是端到端的API响应时间,并不依赖于本地硬件.

blocks.en:
Model input and output. For each hallucination type, all models receive the same input and the same H / N H/N criterion, based on the type’s definition. The input consists of the response to be judged and, when available, the original instruction. For CI, it also includes the source context. The models never see the gold labels or the annotated error spans. Each model answers H H if the response contains the target error and N N otherwise, and returns probabilities P ⁡ ( H ) P(H) and P ⁡ ( N ) P(N) that sum to one. The answer is the label with the higher probability, and on an exact tie we keep the model’s own answer. The decision models return these probabilities through their interfaces. For gpt-6-sol , we ask for a structured verdict with its own probability estimates and no explanation.
Appendix A.4 provides the complete decision-model prompts.
blocks.zh:
模型输入和输出. 对于每一种幻觉类型,所有模型都根据类型的定义得到相同的输入和相同的H / N H/N标准. 输入内容包括要判断的响应和在可获得时的原始指令. 对于CI来说,它也包括源上下文. 模型从未看到金色标签或注释错误跨度. 每个模型如果反应中包含目标错误和N N 反之,则回答H,返回概率 P QQ(H) P(H)和 P QQ(N) P(N) ,总和为1. 答案是贴在概率越高的标签上, 决策模型通过接口返回这些概率。 对于gpt-6-sol,我们要求一个结构化的判决,有其自身的概率估计,没有解释.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. The classes are imbalanced (Table 1 ), so we compare each answer with the gold label and report balanced accuracy (BAcc), the mean recall over H H and N N , and macro-F1, the mean F1 over the two classes. Differences between judges are tested with paired bootstrap over items (2,000 resamples) ( Dror et al., 2018 ) . We also report the mean API latency per call and the estimated API cost. blocks.en: 3.4 Model Ensembling Strategies
blocks.zh: 3.4 示范战略

blocks.en: Motivated by prior studies Verga et al. (2024) ; Badshah et al. (2025) ; Jung et al. (2025) , we evaluate three ensembling methods (Figure 1 ) to assess whether they improve accuracy and at what additional cost. To isolate the effect of each method, we fix the model selection. For each type, all three methods combine the same three decision models, namely those with the highest BAcc on that type.
blocks.zh: 根据先前的研究(Verga等人(2024年)、Badshah等人(2025年)、Jung等人(2025年)的动机,我们评价了三种综艺方法(图1),以评估它们是否提高了准确性,并增加了什么成本。 为了隔离每种方法的效果,我们固定模型选择. 对于每种类型,所有三种方法都结合了相同的三种决定模式,即类型BAcc最高的三种。

blocks.en: Majority voting. All three models judge the same item, and the label chosen by at least two of them is the verdict. Because every item gets all three calls, majority voting is the most expensive of the three methods. Voting gives every model the same weight, so two weaker models can outvote the strongest one.
blocks.zh: 多数投票。 三个模型都对同一个项目进行判断,其中至少两个模型选择的标签是判决. 因为每个项目都收到三个电话,所以多数投票是三种方法中最昂贵的. 投票给每个模型都赋予同样的重量,因此两个较弱的模型可以胜过最强的模型.

blocks.en: Arbitration. When two models agree, the outcome is their shared label, and the third vote does not change it. When they disagree, the third vote decides the outcome. Arbitration therefore calls the two models first and calls the third only to resolve a disagreement ( Badshah et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 仲裁。 当两个模型达成一致时,结果就是他们的共享标签,第三票并不改变. 当他们不同意时,由第三票决定结果. 因此,仲裁将两种模式称为第一模式,将第三种模式称为解决分歧的唯一模式(Badshah等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Confidence cascade. A cascade lets the strongest model decide unless it is uncertain. Cascades usually order models from cheap to expensive to reduce calls to a costly final model ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Jung et al., 2025 ) . We order the models by descending BAcc and ask whether consulting weaker models on the strongest model’s least confident items improves BAcc ( Jitkrittum et al., 2023 ) . At each of the first two stages, a model defers an item to the next model when its confidence c i c_{i} falls below a threshold, and the third model decides all items that reach it. Because confidence distributions differ across models (Section 4.2 ), a common threshold would defer very different shares of items at different stages. We therefore set each threshold through a target deferral rate r k r_{k} , the share of items reaching stage k k that are deferred, so that each stage defers its least confident items without using gold labels. We evaluate r 1 , r 2 ∈ { 0 , 0.1 , … , 0.5 } r_{1},r_{2}\in\{0,0.1,\ldots,0.5\} : r 1 = 0 r_{1}=0 reduces the cascade to the strongest model, and above 0.5 0.5 the strongest model would decide fewer than half of the items. As a control, we defer the same numbers of randomly chosen items.
blocks.zh: 信心级联. 级联让最强的模型决定 除非不确定 Cascades通常订购从廉价到昂贵的模型,以减少呼叫量,成为昂贵的最终模型(Chen等人,2024年;Jung等人,2025年). 我们通过降BAcc来订购模型,并询问在最强模型最缺乏信心的物品上咨询较弱的模型是否改善了BAcc(Jitkrittum等人,2023年)。 在前两个阶段的每一个阶段,当一个模型的置信度c i / = i / i / 低于阈值时,一个模型将一个项目推迟到下一个模型,第三个模型决定所有到达它的项目. 由于不同模型的信心分布不同(第4.2节),一个共同的阈值会在不同阶段推迟非常不同的项目份额。 因此,我们通过目标延缓率r k r_{k}确定每个阈值,即延迟到K阶段的物项份额,以便每个阶段不使用金色标签而推迟其最不信任的物项。 我们评价r 1,r 2 {0, 0.1,..., 0.5} r_{1},r_{2}\in 0.0, 0.1,1,\ldots, 0.5\} :r 1 = 0 r_{1}=0 将级联降低为最强型号,超过0.5 0.5 最强型号将决定不到一半的项目. 作为控制,我们推迟随机选择的相同数目的项目。

blocks.en: Evaluation. For each hallucination type, we evaluate all 6 × 6 6\times 6 combinations of r 1 r_{1} and r 2 r_{2} and report the one with the highest BAcc. Because we choose this combination on the same items we evaluate, the result is an optimistic estimate of what a cascade can achieve ( Cawley and Talbot, 2010 ) . To see how optimistic it is, we also choose the rates with five-fold cross-fitting, picking them on four folds and testing them on the fifth. The cost of an item is the total cost of all models called for it. For latency, we add up calls made one after another and take the slowest of calls made in parallel. We plot each method’s BAcc against its cost, show the results of all 36 combinations separately, and use paired bootstrap tests to compare each method with its best single model and with gpt-6-sol .

blocks.en: Similar scores hide different errors. The matched CI scores arise from different error patterns. pplx rarely raises false alarms (false-positive rate 3.2%) but misses many hallucinations (false-negative rate 31.5%). gpt-6-sol shows the reverse pattern, with a false-negative rate of 5.9% and a false-positive rate of 28.8%. jev lies between them at 20.6% and 14.4%. The dominant error also changes with the task. jev misses most positives on LI, with false-negative rates of 49% on ContraDoc and 81% on ROSCOE, but over-flags on II, where its false-positive rate is 56%. BAcc alone therefore does not show whether a judge mostly misses hallucinations or mostly raises false alarms.
blocks.zh: 类似的分数隐藏不同的错误. 匹配的CI分数来自不同的错误模式. pplx很少引起假警报(假阳性率为3.2%),但错过了许多幻觉(假阴性率为31.5%). gpt-6-sol显示相反模式,假阴性率为5.9%,假阳性率为28.8%. jev位于两者之间,分别为20.6%和14.4%。 主要错误也随任务而变化. jev 错过了 LI 上的大部分阳性反应,其中 ContraDoc 上的假阴性反应率为 49%, ROSCOE 上的假阳性反应率为 81%, 但 II 上的假阳性反应率为 56%。 因此,仅BAcc并不能表明法官多半是错失幻觉,还是大多引起假警报。

blocks.en: Model advantages are concentrated in particular types. Relative to jev , pplx gains only 0.1 points on CI (95% paired bootstrap interval [ − 1.4 , 1.6 ] [-1.4,1.6] ) and loses 0.9 points on FF ( [ − 3.4 , 1.6 ] [-3.4,1.6] ), but it gains 3.9 points on FC ( [ 1.5 , 6.4 ] [1.5,6.4] ), 4.3 points on LI ( [ 2.2 , 6.5 ] [2.2,6.5] ), and 9.3 points on II ( [ 7.2 , 11.5 ] [7.2,11.5] ). The FC, LI, and II gains remain significant after Holm correction over the 25 comparisons of each judge with jev . The ranking of decision models thus changes with the type.

Advantages do not always hold across sources. On HADTest, all six judges score 12 to 18 points higher on FF than on FC. The same comparison on FAVABench shows no consistent gap (Appendix C ). For pplx , FF minus FC is − 1.4 -1.4 points on FAVABench (95% bootstrap interval [ − 8.5 , 5.3 ] [-8.5,5.3] ) but 17.9 17.9 points on HADTest ( [ 13.2 , 22.9 ] [13.2,22.9] ). An advantage on fabrication is therefore partly a property of the source. CI and II each have a single source, so their cross-source stability remains untested.
blocks.zh: 优势并不总是跨越不同来源。 在HAD Test上,所有6名裁判在FF上得分比FC高12到18分. 与FAVA Bench的相同比较显示没有一贯的差距(附录C. 对于pplx,FF减FC在FAVA Bench(95%的靴子间隔[−8.5,5.3][8.5.3])上是−1.4-1.4分,而在HAD Test([13.2,22.9][13.2,22.9])上是17.9 17.9分),因此制造优势部分是来源财产。 CI和II各自有一个单一的源,因此它们的跨源稳定性仍然没有经过测试.

blocks.en: Decision models are far cheaper and faster. Per item, the decision models cost between 0.5% ( pplx ) and 10% ( clef ) of gpt-6-sol , and they answer in 0.22 to 0.62 seconds against 1.6 to 2.6 seconds (Table 2 ). The cheapest model, pplx , is also the most accurate decision model on four of the five types, and gpt-6-luna is the most accurate on FF. The efficiency gain is thus available on every type. Whether it comes with the accuracy of gpt-6-sol depends on the type. Additional analyses of error patterns and prediction overlap across models are provided in Appendix D.2 .

blocks.en: Decision models are overconfident overall, but less so than the GPT-6 models. Every decision model has a positive average overconfidence gap, and the calibration slope is below 1 for 21 of the 25 model–type pairs (Figure 3 a). For jev , pplx , clef and d1 , however, the overconfidence is mild. Mean confidence exceeds accuracy by 0.04 0.04 – 0.12 0.12 , and ECE ranges from 0.083 0.083 to 0.136 0.136 . blocks.en: Calibration depends more on the dataset than on the model. Across the decision models, the dataset accounts for 58% of the variance in the overconfidence gap, and the model for 15% (Figure 3 a). Averaged over the decision models, overconfidence is largest for II ( 0.14 0.14 ) and LI ( 0.13 0.13 ), and smallest for CI and factual contradiction FC ( 0.07 0.07 each). The reliability diagrams show the same pattern. At a given confidence level, accuracy differs by hallucination type (Figure 4 ). For example, the accuracy of gpt-6-luna on CI stays below 0.50 0.50 for all confidence levels between 0.55 0.55 and 0.95 0.95 .
blocks.zh: 校准比模型更依赖于数据集. 在整个决策模型中,数据集占过度自信差距差异的58%,模型占15%(图3a)。 平均而言,II类(0.14 0.14)和LI类(0.13 0.13)的过度自信程度最大,而CI类和事实矛盾FC类的过度自信程度最小(各为0.07 0.07)。 可靠性图显示了相同的模式. 在给定的置信水平上,精度因幻觉类型而异(图4 ). 例如,CI上的gpt-6-luna的精确度在所有置信水平在0.55 0.55和0.95 0.95之间保持在0.50 0.50以下.

blocks.en: Confidence is less reliable for instruction inconsistency (II) and logical inconsistency (LI). Averaged over the decision models, II has the largest overconfidence gap ( 0.14 0.14 ), the highest ECE ( 0.145 0.145 ) and the lowest conf-AUROC ( 0.64 0.64 ), followed by LI (gap 0.13 0.13 ; ECE 0.136 0.136 ; conf-AUROC 0.70 0.70 ). FC is less overconfident (gap 0.07 0.07 ; ECE 0.103 0.103 ) but separates correct from incorrect decisions no better than LI (conf-AUROC 0.70 0.70 ), whereas CI (gap 0.07 0.07 ; ECE 0.093 0.093 ; conf-AUROC 0.74 0.74 ) and FF(gap 0.08 0.08 ; ECE 0.134 0.134 ; conf-AUROC 0.75 0.75 ) are the most reliable. Figure 3 shows the same pattern. Among decisions made with c ≥ 0.9 c\geq 0.9 , accuracy is lowest for II for jev and pplx , and for LI for clef and d1 (Figure 4 ). Type-specific failures also occur for individual models. gpt-6-luna is most overconfident on CI (gap 0.31 0.31 ), where its accuracy stays below 0.50 0.50 .
blocks.zh: 对指令不一致(II)和逻辑不一致(LI)而言,信任程度较低。 在决定模型上,II的过度信任差距最大(0.140.14),欧洲经委会最高(0.1450.145),conf-AUROC最低(0.640.64),其次是LI(0.130.13;欧洲经委会0.1360.136;conf-AUROC0.700.70)。FC的过度信任程度较低(0.07.07;欧洲经委会0.103.0.103),但与不正确的决定相区别并不优于LI(conf-AUROC 0.700.70),而CI(0.07.07;欧洲经委会0.093 0.093;conf-AUROC 0.74 0.74)和FF(gap 0.08;欧洲经委会0.134 0134;conf-AUROC 0.75 0.75)是最可靠的。 图3显示了同样的模式。 在用c 0.9 c\ eq 0.9作出的裁决中,Jev和pplx的II和LI的精确度最低(图4)。 个别模型也会出现特定类型故障。 gpt-6-luna在CI上最自信(gap 0.31 0.31),其精度保持在0.50 0.50.50.

blocks.en:
Confidence separates correct from incorrect decisions only moderately. conf-AUROC measures how well confidence separates correct judgments from errors. A value of 0.5 0.5 indicates performance no better than chance. Higher values indicate better separation between the two groups (Figure 3 b).
Averaged over the five hallucination types, conf-AUROC ranges from 0.67 0.67 ( gpt-6-luna ) to 0.73 0.73 ( pplx and clef ).
For each model and type, the 95% confidence interval lies above 0.5 0.5 , so confidence always carries some information about correctness, but the separation remains moderate, especially for II.
blocks.zh:
信心与错误决定之间只是略有区别。 Conf-AUROC衡量信心如何将判断与错误区分开来. 0.5的数值表明性能并不比机会好。 较高的数值表明,这两类人之间更好的分离(图3b)。
平均在5种幻觉类型中,conf-AUROC从0.67 0.67(gpt-6-luna )到0.73 0.73(pplx和clef )不等.
对于每一种模型和类型来说,95%的置信间隔在0.5 0.5以上,因此信心总是包含一些关于正确性的信息,但分离仍然是温和的,特别是对II.

blocks.en: High confidence does not guarantee a correct decision. Errors can be made with high confidence ( c ≥ 0.9 c\geq 0.9 ) (Figures 4 and 7 ). Averaged over the five types, gpt-6-luna assigns c ≥ 0.9 c\geq 0.9 to 65% of its decisions, is correct on only 77% of them, and makes 47% of its errors at this level. For the other decision models, 10–30% of errors are made at c ≥ 0.9 c\geq 0.9 , with clef lowest (10%); clef also assigns such high confidence to only 25% of its decisions. The comparison model gpt-6-sol is the most extreme case: it assigns c ≥ 0.9 c\geq 0.9 to 88% of its decisions and makes 69% of its errors at this level.
blocks.zh: 高度信任并不能保证作出正确的决定。 错误可以高度置信(c 0.9 c\geq) 0.9) (图4和图7). 平均而言,Gpt-6-luna将C 0.9 c\geq 0.9到65%的决定,只有77%的决定是正确的,并在此一级犯了47%的错误。 对于其他决策模式,10-30%的差错发生在c 0.9 c\ geq 0.9 , 积分最低(10% ) ; 积分也只给予25%的决定如此高的信心。 比较模型gpt-6-sol是最极端的情况:它将c 0.9 c\geq 0.9 至 88%的决定,并在此级别上作出69%的错误.

blocks.en: 4.3 RQ3: Can Ensembling Improve the Performance?
blocks.zh: 4.3 RQ3:能够产生 提高性能?

blocks.en: Figure 5 presents the performance–cost trade-offs of the three ensembling methods. Deferral-rate sensitivity is reported in Appendix Figure 8 .
blocks.zh: 图5显示三种综艺方法的性能-成本权衡。 递延率敏感性在附录图8中报告。

blocks.en: The cascade matches or exceeds GPT-6-sol on three types. At the best tested deferral rates, the confidence cascade achieves BAcc scores of 82.2, 84.6, and 84.6 on FC, FF, and CI, respectively—0.6, 2.6, and 1.9 points higher than gpt-6-sol —at only 1.2–3.3% of its estimated cost. The advantage over gpt-6-sol is statistically significant on FF and CI, but not on FC. The cascade also improves on the strongest single member by 3.3, 1.9, and 2.0 points, respectively, with paired bootstrap 95% intervals excluding zero. It makes 1.1–1.3 calls per item and has about one fifth of the latency of gpt-6-sol . Selecting deferral rates by cross-fitting reduces BAcc by at most 0.52 points and preserves the gains over the strongest member.
blocks.zh: 级联在三种类型上匹配或超过GPT-6-Sol. 在经过最佳测试的延期率下,信心级联在FC、FF和CI的BAcc分数分别为82.2、84.6和84.6,分别比gpt-6-sol高0.6、2.6和1.9分,仅为其估计费用的1.2-3.3%。 相对于gpt-6-sol的优势在FF和CI上具有统计意义,但在FC上则没有. 级联还使最强的单体成员分别提高3.3、1.9和2.0分,配对的靴子间隔95%,不包括0。 它每件都发出1.1–1.3次呼叫,并拥有大约五分之一的gpt-6-sol的延迟. 通过交叉调整来选择延期率,将BAcc最多减少0.52分,并将收益保留在最强成员之上.

blocks.en: The cascade outperforms voting and arbitration. Majority voting gains about one BAcc point over the strongest single model on FC and FF, but falls below it on CI, LI, and II (Figure 5 ). Disagreement arbitration produces the same verdicts as voting while costing roughly half as much. Both rules are less accurate than the cascade on every type and, except on FF, also cost more. Unlike equal voting, the cascade consults weaker members only when the strongest member is uncertain.
blocks.zh: 级联的表现超过了表决和仲裁。 多数人比FC和FF上最强的单一模式获得一个BAcc点,但低于CI、LI和II(图5)。 分歧仲裁产生的判决与表决相同,而费用大约为一半。 两种规则都不如每种类型的级联准确,除了FF之外,成本也更高. 与平等投票不同,级联只有在最强的成员不确定时才与较弱的成员协商.

blocks.en: The best cascade configuration differs by type. pplx leads four of the five cascades. On FF, gpt-6-luna leads (Appendix Table 12 ). The role of the later stages also varies. On CI, the best cascade never uses its third model ( r 2 = 0 r_{2}=0 ), whereas on FF the second model defers about half of the samples it receives. On FC, FF, and CI, BAcc peaks at a first-stage deferral rate of 20–30% and declines at higher rates (Appendix Figure 8 ). A single cascade configuration therefore does not transfer across types.
blocks.zh: 最好的级联配置因类型而异. pplx领导五套级联中的四套. 在FF上,gpt-6-luna线索(附录表12). 后几个阶段的作用也各不相同。 在CI上,最好的级联从未使用过它的第三型号(r 2 = 0 r_{2}=0),而在FF上,第二型号延迟了它收到的大约一半的样品. 在FC、FF和CI方面,BAcc的第一阶段延期率最高,为20-30%,下降率较高(附录图8)。 因此,单一级联配置不会在类型之间转移。

blocks.en: The gap persists on LI and II. On LI, the best cascade defers no items and equals pplx alone, 3.9 points below gpt-6-sol . On II, the cascade improves BAcc by only 0.7 points over the strongest single model, pplx , and remains 7.1 points below gpt-6-sol . Other members do not improve on pplx for its least confident items in balanced terms, consistent with the weaker confidence reliability on these two types (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: LI和II的差距依然存在。 在LI上,最好的级联不推迟任何项目,仅相当于pplx,在gpt-6-sol下3.9分. 在II上,级联将BAcc仅比最强的单型型号pplx改进0.7分,并在gpt-6-sol下保持7.1分. 其他成员对于其最缺乏信心的项目没有作出平衡的改进,这与这两类项目的信心可靠性较弱是一致的(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We evaluate five decision models for hallucination detection. They match or approach the generative LLM judge on factual and context-related errors but lag on logical and instruction inconsistencies requiring multi-step reasoning or explicit constraint checking. We draw three takeaways.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了五种检测幻觉的决定模型。 它们就事实错误和与上下文有关的错误与遗传性 LLM 法官相匹配或接近,但在逻辑和指令不一致方面滞后,需要多步骤推理或明确的制约检查。 我们抽了三个外卖

blocks.en: First, judges should be selected per hallucination type. No decision model performs best across types, and similar BAcc can mask opposite error profiles: missed hallucinations or false alarms. The preferable judge thus depends on the target type and on which error is more costly, so false-negative and false-positive rates should be reported by type. Since type and source are partly confounded, judge selection should be validated on the target task.
blocks.zh: 首先,法官应按幻觉类型挑选。 没有任何决定模型在类型上表现最好,类似的BAcc可以掩盖相反的错误配置:错失幻觉或假警报. 因此,更可取的法官取决于目标类型和哪些错误成本较高,因此,应当按类型报告假阴性和假阳性率。 由于类型和来源部分令人困惑,法官的选择应就目标任务进行验证。

blocks.en: Second, confidence is useful but does not guarantee correctness. Most decision models are less overconfident than gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol , but their confidence only moderately distinguishes correct from incorrect judgments, with frequent high-confidence errors on logical and instruction inconsistencies (Section 4.2 ). Confidence can guide requests for a second opinion but cannot establish correctness.
blocks.zh: 第二,信任是有用的,但并不能保证正确。 与gpt-6-luna和gpt-6-sol 相比,大多数决策模型的过度自信程度较低,但其信心仅略微区别于错误判断,对逻辑和指令不一致之处经常出现高度信心错误(第4.2节)。 信任可以指导对第二种意见的请求,但不能确定正确性。

blocks.en: Third, ensembling decision models helps when they are complementary on uncertain samples. Cascades outperform their strongest member and match or exceed gpt-6-sol on factual contradiction, factual fabrication, and context inconsistency. On logical and instruction inconsistency, the tested cascades offer limited gains, consistent with the observed error overlap (Appendix D.2 ). Since the best configuration varies by type, deferral rates should be validated on the target type to weigh accuracy gains against the cost of additional model calls.
blocks.zh: 第三,共同决策模式在对不确定样本进行补充时有所帮助。 在事实矛盾、事实捏造和上下文不一致方面,连带效应超过其最强成员,与gpt-6-sol相匹配或超过gpt-6-sol。 在逻辑和指令不一致方面,经过测试的级联的收益有限,这与观察到的错误重叠是一致的(附录D.2)。 由于最佳配置因类型不同而异,因此应在目标类型上验证延迟率,以权衡准确性增益与额外模型调用的成本。

blocks.en: At 0.5–10% of the cost of gpt-6-sol , decision models could support low-cost, type-aware cascades for factual and context errors, with LLM judges reserved for logical and instruction inconsistencies. Future work should disentangle type from data source, develop decision models that target reasoning- and instruction-level errors, and learn routing policies that decide when to escalate to an LLM judge based on detection accuracy and cost.
blocks.zh: Gpt-6-sol 成本的0.5-10%,决定模型可以支持低成本的、具有类型意识的级联处理事实和上下文错误,而LLM法官则保留用于逻辑和指令不一致。 今后的工作应当将类型与数据源区分开来,制定针对推理和指导级错误的决策模型,并学习根据检测的准确性和成本决定何时升级为LLM法官的路由政策.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This study presents several future directions.
blocks.zh: 这项研究提出了若干未来方向。

blocks.en: Benchmark coverage and label consistency. Our benchmark covers five hallucination types across six datasets, but coverage is uneven: context and instruction inconsistency each rely on a single source. Differences in data construction, domain, and response length confound cross-dataset comparisons, leaving subgroup analyses observational. Mapping heterogeneous annotations to binary labels may also introduce mismatches because the source datasets define errors differently. Broader source coverage, annotation under a shared rubric, and comparisons matched on domain and response length would help address these limitations.
blocks.zh: 基准覆盖范围和标签一致性。 我们的基准涵盖6个数据集的5种幻觉类型,但覆盖范围参差不齐:上下文和指令不一致,每个来源都依赖单一来源。 数据构造、域和响应长度的差异混淆了跨数据集的比较,留下分组分析观测。 绘制二进制标签的多种说明也可能引入不匹配,因为源数据集对错误的定义不同. 扩大源覆盖面、在共同标题下进行注释以及按域和响应长度进行比较将有助于解决这些限制。

blocks.en: Confidence comparability and prompt sensitivity. Confidence values are not fully comparable because decision models return label probabilities, whereas gpt-6-sol reports its own estimates. We also use one prompt design per task, leaving prompt sensitivity untested. Comparing alternative prompts and, where supported, confidence-elicitation methods within each model would clarify their effects on accuracy and calibration.
blocks.zh: 信任的可比性和迅速的敏感性。 由于决策模型返回标签概率,而gpt-6-sol报告自己的估计数,置信值并不完全可比。 我们还使用每个任务一个即时设计,使迅速的敏感性得不到测试。 比较每个模型中的替代提示和在得到支持的情况下的置信法,可以澄清其对准确性和校准性的影响。

blocks.en: Generalization and deployment of cascades. We evaluate fixed model versions and assess cascades through offline replay and within-source cross-fitting, with member selection and ordering based on the full sample. Selecting all cascade components using training data alone, followed by evaluation on unseen domains and in live deployments, would better assess their accuracy, latency, and cost beyond the evaluated settings.
blocks.zh: 级联的普及和部署。 我们评价固定模型版本,通过离线回放和内源交叉配置来评估级联,成员根据完整的样本进行选择和订购. 仅利用培训数据选择所有级联部分,然后对未见领域和现场部署进行评价,将更好地评估其准确性、耐久性和成本,超越评价范围。

blocks.en: D.2 Error Patterns and Overlap
blocks.zh: D.2 错误模式和重叠

blocks.en: To locate where decision models fail, we break recall of H H down by the source annotations (Table 9 ). The amount of evidence matters most. On RAGTruth, pplx recovers 57% of responses with one annotated span but 96% of those with three or more. On IF-RewardBench, it recovers 46% of responses that violate one constraint but 74% of those that violate three or more. gpt-6-sol recovers 91% and 76% of the single-error cases. Salience matters next. The recall of pplx drops from 71% to 42% for RAGTruth spans annotated only as subtle, and from 91% to 32% for ContraDoc contradictions created by replacing a sentence rather than inserting one. Task form matters as well. All decision models fall to 47 to 63% BAcc on multi-turn instructions, and every judge, including gpt-6-sol , is close to chance on the non-arithmetic ROSCOE chains. The generative judge is not uniformly better either. On RAGTruth data-to-text items, pplx reaches 86% BAcc against 79% for gpt-6-sol .
blocks.zh: 为了找到决策模式失败的地方,我们用源代码说明(表9)打破了HH的下调。 证据的数量是最重要的。 在RAGTruth上,pplx回收了57%的回复,一个附加说明的周期,但96%的回复有三个或三个以上。 在IF-Reward Bench上,它收回了46%的违反一项限制的答复,但74%的违反三项或三项以上。 gpt-6-sol恢复了91%和76%的单发病例. 接下来很重要 对 RAGTruth 来说, pplx 的召回率从 71% 下降到 42% , 而对于 ContraDoc 矛盾来说, 附加一个句子而不是插入一个句子从 91%下降到 32% 。 任务形式也很重要。 包括gpt-6-sol在内的每个法官都接近于在非数学的ROSCOE链上的机会。 基因裁判也并非一成不变。 在 RAGTruth 数据对文本项上, pplx 达到 86% BAcc, 而 gpt-6- sol 则为 79% 。

blocks.en: pplx and gpt-6-sol are both wrong on 4% of CI items, 6 to 8% of FC and FF items, and 11 to 13% of LI and II items. The Jaccard overlap of their error sets rises from 0.13 on CI to 0.50 on LI. Overlap among decision models is higher and is again largest on LI, between 0.51 and 0.57 for pplx against each other decision model. Errors are thus least shared on the types where decision models are already strong and most shared where they are weak. This pattern anticipates RQ3.
blocks.zh: pplx和gpt-6-sol对4%的CI项目、6%至8%的FC和FF项目以及11%至13%的LI和II项目都是错误的。 其错误集的Jaccard重叠从CI上的0.13上升到LI上的0.50。 决策模型的重叠率较高,在液态中再次是最大的,pplx在0.51至0.57之间相互对应决策模型。 因此,在决策模式已经很强的类别上,错误的分担最少,在决策模式较弱的类别上,错误的分担最多。 这种模式预计为RQ3.

blocks.en: FC, FF, and CI peak at intermediate r 1 r_{1} values (20–30%), reaching 82.2%, 84.6%, and 84.6% BAcc, respectively; larger rates eventually reduce performance.
